notes: Shopify store, HTTP fetch (curl) tier-1 only, no bot protection, no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow. Home-page mega-nav has a top-level 'New' menu (data-url /collections/new, H1/title on the page itself is literally 'New arrivals') whose children are ten department pages titled 'Newest Furniture', 'Newest Home Accent', 'Newest Decorative Pillow' (handle newest-cushions-and-blankets), 'Newest Kitchen Decor', 'Newest Curtains', 'Newest Bathroom Accessories' (handle newest-bath-accessories), 'Newest Lighting', 'Newest Wall Art', 'Newest Junior', 'Newest Greenery & Flowers', plus a 'Shop All New' link. All ten department pages and the parent were confirmed via exhaustion-paged /products.json to be genuine, currently-populated PLPs (verified page <title>/<h1> for every one). /collections/shop-all-new (title 'Shop All New') was checked against /collections/new by product-ID set and is a 100% overlap alias (467/467 identical IDs) -- same underlying listing, not recorded as a separate row; canonical URL kept is /collections/new (the literal nav-parent URL whose own H1 says 'New arrivals'). Sum of the ten department children (65+64+61+49+31+21+22+45+45+38=441) does not equal the parent's 467 -- expected and not an error: not every new SKU is bucketed into one of the ten named 'Newest <Department>' pages; the parent /collections/new is the fuller listing. Also checked and EXCLUDED (found via sitemap, not in main nav): /collections/new-basics and /collections/new-essentials -- both return {"products":[]} via /products.json (genuinely 0 products right now), dropped per the zero-product rule. Discovery method: sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (375 handles) grepped for new/newest/just-in/latest/whats-new/nouveau, plus full home-page nav HTML parse for the 'New' mega-menu. Did not use site search (robots.txt disallows /search; nav+sitemap fully covered discovery).
